changelog: New: deck-vs-deck duel mode inside My Decks — pit two saved decks head-to-head, 100/500/1000 games, symmetric win rates + per-axis power-score deltas
New: methodology tooltips on every metric (click the ? icon) + a full methodology page documenting every calculation, formula, and implementing module
Fix: analyst model now re-detects correctly after an in-place installer upgrade — Coach tab picks up a previously-downloaded model without requiring an app restart
Improved: Load saved deck into Analyze tab in one click — sidebar 'Load →' action and a renamed editor button that also sets the format dropdown
